task_commit_basis: first parent of https://github.com/rails/rails/commit/d05a45b41edf679d2dfba4e40366af80628626ff; gh api compare bbaec1c66840...d05a45b41edf touches exactly the pull request's files

reference_change.title: Speed up `String#blank?` further by avoiding repeated `bytesize` calls

workload.command: docker run --rm --init --stop-timeout 10 --name perfproof-rails-rails-pr59030-workload -e BUNDLE_WITHOUT=rubocop:mdl:doc:job:cable:storage -v .:/src -v perfproof-gems:/usr/local/bundle -w /src/activesupport perfproof-ruby-4.0-tzdata-legacy bundle exec ruby --yjit -Ilib -e "require 'active_support'; require 'active_support/core_ext/object/blank'; inputs = ['   ', ' ' * 136, ' this is a longer test', \"\\n\"]; 200_000.times { inputs.each { |s| s.blank? } }"
workload.source: adapted from the benchmark-ips script in the description of https://github.com/rails/rails/pull/59030 (String#blank? on whitespace-only and short ASCII strings, the inputs it reports as faster, under YJIT): 200,000 passes over four strings

oracle.command: docker run --rm --init --stop-timeout 10 --name perfproof-rails-rails-pr59030-oracle -e BUNDLE_WITHOUT=rubocop:mdl:doc:job:cable:storage -v .:/src -v perfproof-gems:/usr/local/bundle -w /src/activesupport perfproof-ruby-4.0-tzdata-legacy bundle exec ruby -Itest -e "require './test/core_ext/object/blank_test'"
oracle.source: Active Support's blank? tests (test/core_ext/object/blank_test.rb covers the file https://github.com/rails/rails/pull/59030 changes); targeted tests only

evidence.note: description, as matched by the miner: speedup claims: 1.10x; 1.29x; 1.23x; 1.16x; 1.46x | timings: 100ms; 47.46 ns; 5.089023s; 47.94 ns; 5.034041s; 108.78 ns; 5.004132s; 108.10 ns

status_reason: built here and ran workload and oracle on the task and reference trees; see runs. Ruby is not installed here, so it runs under Docker (a linux/arm64 VM on this Mac) in the official ruby:4.0 image plus tzdata-legacy (eval/tasks/workloads/_images/ruby-4.0-tzdata-legacy/Dockerfile): Debian trixie keeps the legacy US/* zone names Active Support's tests use in that package. Gems are the tree's Gemfile.lock (bundler 4.0.12), without the rubocop, mdl, doc, job, cable and storage groups
